root_cause: Broad pull-request workflows executed heavyweight CodeQL and Supabase preview preparation even when a candidate did not touch those runtime surfaces, increasing queue pressure and feedback latency without adding relevant evidence.
contributing_causes: Powerhouse CodeQL had no cheap changed-file applicability stage for pull requests.
Supabase Preview Applicability checked out full history before determining that no supabase/** path had changed.
High workflow fan-out amplified unnecessary runner queue contention.
prevention_rule: Keep required workflows visible on every pull request, perform a cheap changed-file applicability decision first, and run heavyweight provider or security work only when the relevant source surface changed. The applicability gate must never weaken the underlying security or provider verification.

observed: Supabase Preview Applicability completed successfully in about eight seconds on a non-Supabase candidate after the pre-check was added.
CodeQL applicability completed successfully before heavyweight analysis on the exact candidate.
